title: Usiphus Faculty Review Rubric
description: Standard rubric for automated screening + human faculty review

categories.name: Clinical Accuracy
categories.description: Claims align with current evidence and guidelines
checks: No absolute statements where evidence is limited

categories.name: Completeness & Clarity
categories.description: Clear, appropriate, and covers required scope

categories.name: Source & Content Currency
categories.description: References and content are up to date

categories.name: Internal Consistency
checks: No contradictions within or across topics

categories.name: Educational & Exam Suitability
categories.description: Appropriate for stated audience and purpose

actions.>=85: ✅ Auto-screened — ready for batch faculty sign-off
